tolerance_rationale: ADR 0005 (2026-11-13 revision): the operator criterion applies to 8-bit and wider -- |delta| <= 1 code AND cosine >= 0.9999. 8W8A uses int8 weights, per-channel s[n]=max|W[n,:]|/127, int32 per-channel bias, and the two-step requant of tools/quant_contract.py; int8_tol=1 is registered here (the ADR allowance), while the ticket expects bit-exactness -- tools/compare.py prints the exact counts, so 0 codes is reported as 0/14336, never inferred from PASS.

precision_tier.requant: tools/quant_contract.py: two integer roundings, per-channel multipliers

quality_criterion.code_criterion: device vs quantised golden: |delta| <= int8_tol codes

accuracy_vs_fp32.note: int8 quantisation error of the whole 4W8A path, no device involved
